text: The colony is a caste society. One queen, the only fertile female, laying up to two thousand eggs a day. Thousands of sterile female workers, who clean, nurse, build, guard and finally forage. And a few hundred drones, males that hatch from unfertilised eggs, so they are haploid. What makes a queen? Diet. Every larva gets royal jelly for about three days, but only the future queen is kept on it.
